title: You can reply to a WhatsApp group from TD Social
text: Open a group in the WhatsApp tab and write to it like any chat. Text, files and voice notes work. Before sending, the confirm step shows a clear warning that you are writing to the whole group and that it cannot be taken back. As before, you can only reply in a group where someone has already written, and the same speed limits apply.
points: Only groups where someone already wrote

steps.name: Open the group
steps.detail: It has the green Group label.

steps.name: Write your message
steps.detail: Press send to reach the confirm step.

steps.name: Check the group name, then confirm
steps.detail: The amber note names the group.
